name: Jiangxi Hungpai New Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Hungpai New Material Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of functional silanes and nano-silicon materials, and other chemical additives in China and internationally. The company provides alkyl silane coupling agent, amino silane coupling agent, anti adhesion agent, chloroalkyl silane coupling agent, epoxy silane coupling agent, silicone oil, fumed silica, phenyl silane coupling agent, silicate ester, sulfur silane coupling agent, thiocyanato silane coupling agent, and vinyl silanes coupling agent.
